mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances with rising FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in unemployment rate and decline in monthly job gains indicates a weakening labor market, depressing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over the last 3 years, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In CPIAUCSL > 3% YoY periods, SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over the last 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1200 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1200 fails to predict negative returns in more than 45% of cases over the last 3 years, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and slowdown in quarterly GDP growth indicates economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and slowing GDPC1 fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases over the last 3 years, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases fail to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases over the last 3 years, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate above 1.5% within the past week signals immediate monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 1.5% fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 45% of cases over the last 3 years, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
